description.value: A family-oriented private campground nestled along the Sooke River and De Mamiel Creek, 45 minutes from Victoria on paved Highway 14, with flush washrooms and coin showers, river access for paddling, wildlife watching, and a playground — open seasonally late March to mid-October with tent sites priced at the higher end of private campground rates.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active, community-owned campground on the Sooke River operated by the Sooke Community Association, opening March 27 2026 (current season). Amenities page lists showers, free wireless, sani-dump, playground, firewood, ice, propane, snacks, and boat launch. Reservations are accepted via online booking. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, laundry, or bike tools. Phone (250-642-6076) and address (2259 Phillips Road) come from the website; OSM had neither.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; values sourced from the website only
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active seasonal campground on Highway 14 near Sooke, a key stop on Vancouver Island's Pacific Marine Circle Route. Offers tent sites, showers, Wi-Fi, and on-site supplies useful for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: community-owned campground... showers, free wireless... snacks... key stop on Vancouver Island's Pacific Marine Circle Route
